apps/web/components/features/admin/lists.permission-denied: The index sits on an admin-only route that the server layout gates before it renders, and it takes no role or permission input. The detector matched role='status' on the loading placeholder.
The workspace sits on an admin-only route that the server layout gates before it renders, and it takes no role or permission input. The detector matched role='status' on the loading placeholder.

apps/web/components/features/admin/lists.long-content: The control draws five fixed icon buttons and no visible text; the label prop is only the fieldset's aria-label, so no caller text can overflow. The detector matched the label prop.

apps/web/components/features/admin/outbo.offline: The panel never fetches: it takes resolved readiness plus isLoading and isError flags, so an offline request reaches it as isError (ErrorCouldNotLoad). The detector matched the isLoading prop.

apps/web/components/features/admin/outbo.permission-denied: The workspace sits on an admin-only route that the server layout gates before it renders, and it takes no role or permission input. The detector matched role='toolbar' on the view tabs.

apps/web/components/features/admin/outre.long-content: The panel's own copy is fixed (title='DM queue', a fixed subtitle and a numeric count); lead names and DM copy are drawn by DmQueueCard, which owns their overflow. The detector matched the title and subtitle props it passes to ContentSectionHeader.

apps/web/components/features/admin/syste.empty: The only prop is activeTab; lists come from the checked-in connector and skill registries, which a story cannot empty. AdminSystemMap.test.tsx renders the 'No tools registered.' branch with a mocked registry.
apps/web/components/features/admin/syste.long-content: The only prop is activeTab; every label and description comes from the checked-in connector and skill registries, so no caller text can grow. The detector matched c.label, t.name and t.description.

apps/web/components/features/admin/syste.empty: The tab takes no props and lists the checked-in SKILL_REGISTRY, which a story cannot empty. AdminSystemMapSkillsTab.certificate.test.tsx renders the zero-skill count line with a mocked registry.
apps/web/components/features/admin/syste.long-content: The tab takes no props; its one line of copy is fixed and each skill's text is drawn by SkillDocCard (LongContentSkill). The detector matched the name and description props it passes down.

apps/web/components/features/admin/table.empty: The header holds no rows or collection: it draws five fixed column headings. The detector matched the items-center layout classes.
apps/web/components/features/admin/table.long-content: Every heading is fixed copy ('Creator', 'Social', 'Actions' and the Created sort label) and each cell is whitespace-nowrap, so no caller text can grow. The detector matched the label prop on SortableHeaderButton.

apps/web/components/features/admin/waitl.error: The table takes its rows as props and never fetches, so it has no failed face to draw; a failed copy or approval is a toast. AdminWaitlistTableUnified.test.tsx asserts the 'Failed to copy name' toast. The detector matched toast.error.
apps/web/components/features/admin/waitl.offline: The table takes its rows as props and never fetches; isFetchingNextPage is passed through to the shared table (LoadingNextPage) and an offline approval fails as a toast from useApproveEntry. The detector matched isLoading={false} and isFetchingNextPage.

apps/web/components/features/admin/waitl.empty: The card draws exactly one entry and holds no collection. The detector matched the items-start and items-center layout classes; missing optional fields are shown by PartialEntry.
